correctness.rationale: Distinct degree-two characters differ on symmetric-difference sets of cardinality two or four, so the probability-normalized full-shell Gram matrix is I iff the two- and four-coordinate moments vanish. The Newton/symmetric expansion m2=(s²−n)/(n(n−1)), m4=(s⁴−(6n−8)s²+3n(n−2))/(n(n−1)(n−2)(n−3)) gives E U=n, E U²=n(3n−2), Var U=2n(n−1)>0 for U=s². Carathéodory in R² using the exact uniform cube barycenter yields at most three positive shell weights. A two-point distribution necessarily has squared levels a²<n<b² and unique weights, and variance (n−a²)(b²−n), giving the iff test. Mod-8/16 square residues forbid two in 4,5,7 mod8. Both infinite families satisfy equality identically and meet shell parity. Independently enumerated every point in n=6 shells s=0 and s=4 with weights 5/8 and 3/8, and checked the full 15×15 Gram matrix equals I in exact Fraction arithmetic. No finite enumeration substitutes for Carathéodory or the modular proof.
